en: The image is a black-and-white photograph depicting a rural scene by a lake or river. In the foreground, a man is plowing a field using a horse-drawn plow. The man wears a brimmed hat and modest rural clothing. In the background, there are small wooden houses, a sloping hillside, and a few small boats on the water. The general environment suggests a temperate, possibly Nordic or Northern European countryside. In the upper left corner, there is handwritten text which seems to be a number or date.
